Both begin by saying the President had long anticipated the official's departure but nevertheless accepts it with deep reluctance because of personal circumstances; both then praise the official's distinctive contribution to the Administration, connect that work to broader national values, note appreciation among executive colleagues, and close with regret at the loss and good wishes. C09 and C15 share substantial resignation-letter structure and some closer individual motifs, but C01 offers the strongest overall combination of language, sequence, presidential voice, and administrative context.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"While I have known for some weeks that your departure from public service was imminent ... In view of the personal factors involved, however, I have no alternative but to accept it ... with great reluctance.","parent_excerpt":"While I have long been aware that you would not be able to carry on indefinitely ... it is with deepest regret that I accept the fact that personal obligations compel you to leave Government","explanation":"Distinctive parallel opening: prior awareness of an impending departure, personal circumstances compelling it, and reluctant acceptance."},{"child_excerpt":"You have made a unique contribution to the labors of this Administration ... Your intellectual proficiency and skill, together with your strength of character and resolute spirit","parent_excerpt":"courage, unflagging effort, and broad sympathetic understanding have been indispensable requirements ... It is a tribute to your wise judgment and devoted service","explanation":"Both move from acceptance to an extended appraisal of the official's personal qualities and contribution to a major Administration achievement."},{"child_excerpt":"The wide respect in which the Council is held today, not only in the Executive Branch but throughout the government and the country as well, is ample evidence of your work","parent_excerpt":"the Department and Agency heads with whom you have worked closely throughout this Administration share in the deep feeling of appreciation that I have","explanation":"Both invoke the broader Executive Branch's regard as confirmation of the departing official's successful service."},{"child_excerpt":"My best wishes accompany you as you return to private life. My own personal sense of loss is eased by the knowledge that you will be available to help us from time to time","parent_excerpt":"We shall sorely miss your presence ... To my sincere thanks for your fine contribution I add all best wishes for health and happiness in the future.","explanation":"Parallel closing sequence of anticipated loss, gratitude, and personal good wishes."}]}
